parts.t: Neighbourhood guide · City of Delta · North Delta

Sunshine Hills Woods is an MLS® sub-area in the south part of North Delta, in the City of Delta. On the MLS® map it starts at about 72 Avenue and runs south, with homes on streets such as Lyon Road, Summit Crescent, Chateau Wynd and Carncross Crescent.
is to the north. Watershed Park, Delta’s largest park, is nearby.

Written by Jared Gibbons, REALTOR®, Royal LePage Little Oak Realty, on October 15, 2026. I have worked in Lower Mainland real estate for 11+ years. Facts come from the official sources noted on this page. Rules and boundaries change, so confirm anything important with the City of Delta and Delta School District.
Not legal, planning or financial advice. Confirm zoning, plan designations and school catchments before you buy or sell.

parts.t: Zoning and plan designations can be different for each lot.
Delta Council adopted the Official Community Plan 2024, “Housing Our Future” (Bylaw No. 8400), on July 8, 2024.
The City’s 2024 OCP does not use the name Sunshine Hills Woods. It is an MLS® sub-area name, so ask me whether a specific address is in it.
The OCP names the 72 Avenue corridor and the R6 Scott Road RapidBus corridor among North Delta’s growth areas. 72 Avenue is on this area’s north side and Scott Road is on its east side.

A 2022 City staff report calls Cougar Creek a salmon-bearing creek that flows through mostly developed parts of Surrey and Delta. It says development and climate change have raised storm water flows and creek bed erosion.

Delta changed its zoning in 2024 so that many single detached and duplex lots can have a secondary suite plus up to two detached suites (a garden suite or coach house). The rules differ by lot, so ask me or the City about an address.
From MLS® sales data (not an official source): the median lot size of detached houses sold from July 1 to October 8, 2026 was 6,480 square feet, across 19 sales with a recorded lot size.

blocks.text: Before you buy in Sunshine Hills Woods

parts.t: Check the creek and ravine land.
If a home backs on Cougar Creek or a ravine, ask the City about streamside rules, erosion and any covenants on title. The City has reported erosion along the creek.
Ask the City what the plans allow on the lots around the home, especially along 72 Avenue and Scott Road.
Use the Delta School District school locator for the exact address.
For a strata home, read the documents.
The depreciation report, meeting minutes, bylaws and fees, plus any special levies.
Ask whether it was built with a permit before you count on it.

Is Sunshine Hills Woods an official City neighbourhood?
Not by that name. The City of Delta’s 2024 Official Community Plan does not use it, so it is an MLS® sub-area name. The guide places facts by address and says so where a boundary is not official.
Which schools are in Sunshine Hills Woods?
Elementary schools are Sunshine Hills (11285 Bond Boulevard), Pinewood (11777 Pinewood Drive), Heath (11364 72 Avenue) and Cougar Canyon (11664 Lyon Road), all kindergarten to grade 7.
